name: Zenind
summary: Online US company formation for LLCs and corporations, with registered agent, EIN and BOI report preparation, compliance reminders and a company dashboard, aimed at founders inside and outside the US.
best_for: founders, including non-US founders, who want to form a US LLC or corporation online and compare a clear one-time package price, and who will check the yearly add-ons
skip_if: you need legal or tax advice on how to structure the company, or you already have a US registered agent and only want the cheapest possible state filing
honest_knock: The $0 Basic package covers filing only. A registered agent costs $99 a year on every package, the operating agreement is $99 extra on Basic, and state filing fees always come on top, so the real first-year cost is well above $0. Basic also takes up to 7 days to file. Annual report filing is included only on Premium and only for the first year, then $100 a year plus state fees. Zenind is not a law firm and does not give legal advice. We have not used Zenind ourselves.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on zenind.com/pricing in a browser render, USD) Three US company formation packages, each a one-time fee plus state filing fees, which the page showed as $120.00 as it loaded and which change with the state you choose. Basic is $0.00: name availability check, preparation and filing of the state documents, filing within 7 days, lifetime customer support and an online company dashboard. Standard is $149.00: filing in 3 days, plus EIN application preparation, BOI report preparation, membership or stock certificates, a prepared operating agreement or bylaws, and meeting minutes. Premium is $249.00: filing in 1 business day, plus the compliance and annual report service (first year included, then $100 a year) and a dedicated account manager. Every package says an additional $99 a year applies if you use Zenind's registered address and registered agent service. Separately priced: registered agent $99 a year in all 50 states and DC, operating agreement or bylaws $99 one-time on Basic, an extra BOI report $29, certificate of good standing $99 plus government fees, federal trademark registration $199 plus USPTO fees, sales and use tax registration $299 plus government fees, and online notary $25 plus $10 per extra seal.

free_plan_evidence: The $0 Basic package covers filing only.

compare_with.name: doola
compare_with.why: doola is in our dossiers too and also forms US companies for founders, often from outside the US. Zenind sells one-time packages from $0 plus state fees and charges the registered agent, compliance and extra documents separately; compare both on the total for the first two years, including the registered agent and annual report filing.
